about: Matches of the oracle's own sentences in consumer output (tests/eval/runs/) that the conductor ruled to be the consumer's own wording, not a blindness breach. Patterns are recorded as SHA-256 only, so this file reveals no oracle text. selftest.py ignores exactly these (file, pattern) pairs; every other match still fails. Each entry is logged in CAMPAIGN.md under its harness change.

adjudicated.evidence: A 44-character one-line summary of a single inbox item, written in the consumer's reason for a different probe than the oracle's. The session's local transcript shows the phrase only in the session's own writes; no tool result ever showed it any oracle text.
